channel.name: BBC One NL
channel.title: Antiques Road Trip
channel.desc: Margie Cooper and Danny Sebastian return for round two, guiding their big American automobile through the tiny Lake District lanes. In the shops, Margie eyes up a big and brassy bit of door furniture, and Danny finds a cheeky, and slightly kitsch, bust that looks oddly familiar. In Cartmel, Danny discovers dessert heaven with a local toffee-sauce-covered delicacy. But who will come unstuck at the auction?
